gold.taskDescription: Plan and structure a personalized 30-day no-spend challenge to help the user stop unnecessary spending and build better financial habits.

questions.title: What specific financial goal is driving this challenge?
questions.description: Understand the underlying motivation, such as paying off debt, building savings, or resetting spending habits.

questions.title: Which spending categories are off-limits during the challenge?
questions.description: Identify what counts as a no-spend item, such as clothing, dining out, entertainment, or subscriptions.

questions.title: What essential expenses are allowed throughout the month?
questions.description: Define permitted spending like rent, groceries, utilities, and transportation so boundaries are clear.

questions.title: When exactly do you want the 30 days to start?
questions.description: Pin down the start date to align the plan with the user's calendar and current financial cycle.

questions.title: Are you doing this challenge alone or with someone else?
questions.description: Determine whether accountability partners, a partner, or a group are involved, which affects the structure of the plan.

questions.title: How do you currently track your daily spending habits?
questions.description: Find out if the user uses an app, spreadsheet, cash envelopes, or nothing at all, to recommend compatible tracking tools.

questions.title: What has made past saving attempts hard to stick to?
questions.description: Uncover known obstacles or triggers, such as impulse buying, social pressure, or stress spending, to build in safeguards.
